text: Issue 0002 is fixed before any `version` command runs against Conflab: a sidecar whose kind devbin has no recipe for is REFUSED by name rather than overwritten, `read_version` reports the same absence rather than false drift, and a `Cargo.lock` recipe rewrites the named package entries only. The proving test asserts BOTH that the destination file is byte-identical AND that the command exited non-zero -- a content-only assertion passes against a `die` that never ran
